scope: Secure native first initialization and real official MySQL lifecycle; developer Windows 10 only.

native_test.scope: Secure native initialization, TLS query, backup and restore from only the standalone EXE; developer Windows 10 only.
limits: Tests use Windows 10 10.0.19044 on the developer host, not a clean Win7/10/11 matrix.
Windows 10 loads its system UCRT; app-local UCRT execution on Win7 remains unverified.
Native initialization generates a local credential; GUI password configuration and cross-machine migration remain untested.
No GUI backup/rollback workflow or final complete offline package acceptance.

policy.official_initialization: --initialize with expired random temporary root credential
policy.bootstrap_transport: Random local named pipe with TCP disabled
policy.generated_password: 24 CNG random bytes encoded as 48 hex characters; no command-line or ordinary-output password
policy.sensitive_file_permissions: Protected current-Windows-user-only DACL; inheritable rules on data directory
policy.existing_data: Refused; full file membership and content hashes preserved
policy.failure: Data and private diagnostics retained; unfinished owned child is stopped explicitly
